description: This file contains functions related to Windows filesystem monitoring, including checking remote protocol information for directories and identifying if a filesystem path is remote. It includes system calls specific to Windows (e.g., CreateFileW, GetFileInformationByHandleEx, GetDriveTypeW) and handles wide-character strings for path management.

methods.name: int check_remote_protocol(wchar_t * wpath)
methods.description: Checks if the specified directory path is associated with a remote filesystem by obtaining remote protocol info via Windows API.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__get_fs_info(const char * path,struct fs_info * fs_info)
methods.description: Determines whether the given filesystem path is remote and retrieves protocol information if applicable.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__is_fs_remote(const char * path)
methods.description: Public function that returns whether a given filesystem path is on a remote filesystem.

methods.name: int fsmonitor__get_alias(const char * path UNUSED,struct alias_info * info UNUSED)
methods.description: No-op function intended for future alias resolution, currently always returns 0.

methods.name: char * fsmonitor__resolve_alias(const char * path UNUSED,const struct alias_info * info UNUSED)
methods.description: No-op function intended for resolving path aliases, currently returns NULL.

ctags.name: fsmonitor__get_alias
ctags.signature: (const char * path UNUSED,struct alias_info * info UNUSED)

ctags.name: fsmonitor__resolve_alias
ctags.signature: (const char * path UNUSED,const struct alias_info * info UNUSED)
